item.title: The Almanac 0.5.1
item.description:
• Your folders now read bigger PDFs and Word and Pages documents. The Almanac reads text, Markdown, code and config; PDFs (page by page, only the beginning of a PDF past 5,000 pages or 20 MB of text); Word (.docx, .doc, .rtf, .odt) and single-file Pages documents. Answers cite "paragraphs 12–18" for Word, Pages and RTF files.
  • Text and notes are searchable at once; documents follow, smallest first, so a big PDF never holds the rest of a folder up.
  • A document that can't be read is skipped, not stuck: a locked PDF, a password-protected Word file, an old Pages format or a Pages file saved as a package, and a file that takes too long. It's tried again when the file changes. Settings › Sources says how many files were skipped and why.
  • On this update your folders are re-read from scratch in the background (the way the Almanac splits files changed). Each folder becomes searchable again as the re-read reaches it, text files first; your files are never changed.
